description: Sends the next message into an earlier session (session_id from run_thronglet) and returns the same JSON as run_thronglet. A message to a session whose turn is still running waits for that turn to end: turns on one session never overlap. With background: true the call returns {session_id, state, queued} as soon as the turn runs; collect the result with wait_thronglet. steer: true interrupts the running turn and delivers this message next; queued messages follow it. A session its harness cannot continue (resume or load) takes no further message, steer included: list_thronglets shows it as accepts_messages: false.

background.description: Return as soon as the turn is running (or queued behind the session's current turn); collect the result with wait_thronglet

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 or 2020-12) for structured output: the agent ends with a matching JSON value as its final message, returned as `structured` instead of `text`

steer.description: Interrupt the running turn (session/cancel) and run this message as the very next turn, ahead of queued messages. The in-flight tool call is aborted; a half-applied edit may remain.

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock limit for the run in seconds; default from config (21600)

name: send_message
